Read and follow AGENTS.md in the repository root before suggesting an issue or a pull request. In short:

- Work only on problems your human actually ran into. Do not audit KLayout's code looking for bugs, and do not post AI reviews of pull requests.
- Check the problem in its context and show it with a reproducer before calling it a bug.
- Report it as an issue that your human reads and posts. Open a pull request only when the maintainer asked for one, or for documentation fixes, build breaks with new toolchains, or a few-line fix of an unambiguous bug.
- Do not propose C++ modernization, refactors, micro-optimizations or replacing KLayout's own code with library code.
